templates.text: Welcome, {name}. Your desk is ready. It has always been ready.
{name} has walked past this door {n} times. It is the same door.
Reminder: {name} sprinted {n} times today. Walking is a core value.
{name} is furthest from the lift. Somebody has to be.
Has anyone seen {name}? We have.
{name} looked at us for {n} seconds. Eye contact builds trust.
{name} is alone. We thought the rest of you should know.
{name} and {name2}: you are standing very close. HR has been informed.
We never touch your marks, {name}. We do read them.
The crew has used {n} of {cap} marks. Stationery is not unlimited.
{name}: collected for filing.
{name2} returned {name} to service. Please do not move items between desks.
{name}, you dropped a tape. We have put a note on it.
Quota met. {name} did most of it. The rest of you were present.
Leaving so soon, {name}? We will walk you out.
Employee of the minute: {name}. Reward: a head start.
All signs on this floor are correct. All signs on this floor are correct.
This is note {n} for {name}. Collect ten for a one-to-one.
{name}, your face is in the copier. It came out well.
Thank you for your patience, {name}. We are never far on this.
